label: Platsbanken
terms_note: Swedish PES; open JobTech API (no key needed) — client not written; apply to the employer.

endpoints.call: api for search — Arbetsförmedlingen JobTech 'JobSearch' API v1.37 (Swagger): GET https://jobsearch.api.jobtechdev.se/search (q, qfields, occupation-name/-group/-field/-collection, skill, language, emp
endpoints.notes: from the docs / live response read on 2026-09-05

reference.limits: No rate limit stated in the Swagger; Open data from the Swedish Public Employment Service (data.arbetsformedlingen.se); the Getting Started guide says 'you need a key to authenticate yourself' (registered on jobtechdev.se, which did not resolve from the audit host) — the /search endpoint nevertheless answered 200 to an unauthenticated test call today. No rate limit stated in the Swagger; the docs recommend the Stream API for bulk.

search.note: Arbetsförmedlingen JobSearch API v1.37 (Swagger at https://jobsearch.api.jobtechdev.se/swagger.json): q = 'Freetext query. Search in ad headline, ad description and employer name', offset 'Valid range is (0-2000)', limit 'Valid range is (0-100)', remote 'True will return ads which are likely to allow remote work'. municipality/region/country take JobTech taxonomy codes, so location and country are not sent — put the place name in query instead. The getting-started guide asks for a key to use the Swagger GUI, but the Swagger declares no security scheme and /search answered without one on 2026-09-24. 429 on too many requests (no threshold published).

get_posting.note: 'Load a job ad by ID' (404 when the ad is gone). description.text is plain text; description.text_formatted, application_details (url/email/via_af) and occupation stay in raw.

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none') and no account endpoint in the Swagger.
not_offered.apply: Page: 'apply to the employer' — ads carry application_details.url / email; there is no application endpoint.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the Swagger documents search, complete, ad and logo only.

live_check.notes: all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
